company.description: Exin Therapeutics is developing a discovery platform for next-generation genetic therapies targeting dysregulated neural circuits across disorders, and next-generation neurotherapeutics leverage advancements in genetics, technology, and engineering to create innovative treatments for neurological disorders. These therapies, which include gene therapy, nucleotide-based therapeutics, and cell-based therapies, address previously untreatable disease mechanisms and unmet medical needs.
